summary: Round 3 passes with no blocker. B2-1 is fixed and verified by probes and reruns. The A3-3 preview-folder symlink refusal closes the write-through. One new nonblocking Major (B3-1) stays: a valid relative symlink under docs/ can redirect the Phase 5 publish copy outside docs/. security_applicability: applicable: test-strategy.md section 9, Phase 1 row assigns Review B the publish gate, the no-docs/-write rule, and the no-real-export-bytes rule. The round-3 diff changes preview.sh, publish.ts, and real-work.ts, which hold that gate.
nonblocking_findings: B3-1 [Major] review-b: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:169-173 with harness/model-guide/preview.sh:103-112: a valid symlink under docs/ with a relative target can redirect a publish write outside docs/. Probe in a git archive of d14becb: docs/rel-alias.html linked to ../outside.html. cp -a at preview.sh:112 copies the link string into the preview. The string resolves to <repo>/outside.html from docs but to <repo>/.tmp/outside.html from the preview folder. preview-base.json pins the docs-side hash (H1). The approval row carries the preview-side hash (H2), so the drift check at publish.ts:141-167 passes. writeFileSync at publish.ts:172 then follows the docs link and overwrites the outside file: exit 0, content changed H1 to H2. A ../../ target wrote a file two levels above docs/. isSafeRelPath at publish.ts:58-63 checks only the logical row path, and docsFiles at publish.ts:92-108 uses statSync, which follows links. A directory symlink fails closed with `publish: drift dirlink/<file>`. Reachability in Phase 1 is zero: git ls-tree shows no tracked symlink, no publish-approval.md exists in the d14becb tree, and the copy loop writes only approved rows after Daniel's word. Fix before the Phase 5 first publish: make preview.sh refuse every symlink under docs/ (the line 103 scan drops the dangling test), and make publish.ts use lstatSync in docsFiles and push every non-regular entry to the broken list so drift exits 2 before the copy. Add a failing-first test that plants a relative docs symlink and names it in an approval row.

The harness/ and model_guide paths are byte-identical at d14becb and HEAD, so the d14becb tree audit is current. Every probe ran in a git archive d14becb copy under /tmp/opencode/rb3-3390667. The real docs/ folder was never touched.

B2-1 withdrawn: publish.ts:97-102 wraps statSync and maps a failure to the broken list; publish.ts:156-161 wraps the drift hash read; preview.sh:103-107 refuses a dangling docs entry before any write. Temp-copy probes: dangling docs link in preview gave exit 2, `preview: unreadable docs/dangling.txt`, no traceback, no preview folder; dangling docs link in publish gave exit 2, `publish: drift dangling.txt`, no traceback, docs snapshot unchanged; a mode-000 docs file in publish gave exit 2, `publish: drift locked.txt`, no traceback, docs snapshot unchanged. The three B2-1 tests in preview-gate.test.ts pass at d14becb and are listed as failed on aa894a7 in red-1.14.txt items 9 to 11.

A3-3 verified: preview.sh:94-100 scans an existing preview folder with find -type l before any write. Probe: a planted preview/real-work.json symlink to an outside sink and a subfolder link to docs gave exit 2, `preview: refused path <preview>/real-work.json`, docs unchanged, the outside sink file unchanged, and no docs/real-work.json. The red record item 7 shows exit 0 and a docs write on aa894a7, so the test is not vacuous.

B3-1 probe facts: a relative docs symlink passed the preview dangling scan because the link target exists. The preview copy kept the link (os.path.islink true). preview-base.json held the docs-side resolution hash, which matched the outside H1 file. The preview-side resolution matched a different H2 file. Publish with an approval row for the link path exited 0 and replaced H1 with H2 outside docs/. A ../../ link reached /tmp/opencode/deep-write.txt, two levels above docs/. A directory symlink gave exit 2 with `publish: drift dirlink/link-target.html` and no outside change. A control publish with no symlink wrote only the two approved rows into docs/.

Staging safety: preview.sh:80-81 creates one mktemp -d folder and installs trap rm -rf. The count of /tmp/tmp.* entries was 84 before and 84 after a refused run. A refusal into a new nested preview left no leaf and no parent folder. Path refusals for --preview docs, docs/assets, /, ., a symlink to docs, and a missing export each gave exit 2 before mktemp ran.

Review A items from the security side only, not repeated: A4-1 is fail-closed. A mode-000 docs file makes cp fail with exit 1 and leaves no preview-base.json, so a later publish hits `publish: no preview base`. The dead sys.exit branch at preview.sh:138 would raise NameError while the base dict is built at preview.sh:154, before preview-base.json is written at preview.sh:156. No docs write occurs on either path. A4-3 is fail-closed: a mode-000 docs directory gave exit 1 with an EACCES stack from publish.ts:93, but the throw happens in docsFiles at publish.ts:142, before the copy loop at publish.ts:169, and the docs snapshot was unchanged.

No docs write: git diff --name-only 0a44cc9..d14becb -- docs/ is empty. git status --short docs/ in the real repo is empty. find docs -type l in the real repo returns 0. The d14becb tree holds no publish-approval.md (git ls-tree count 0), so publish always exits 2 with `publish: no approval record` in Phase 1; a probe confirmed that line.

No real export bytes or SHA in product or test files: no real-work-outcomes-2026 file is tracked. The full export SHA appears only in measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md, plan.md, and metadata.json, and it already appears there at the phase base 0a44cc9. The split needles in leak-guard.test.ts keep the test folder clean, and that file passes. No daniebo, home path, or handoff string appears under harness/model-guide or harness/model-guide-tests at d14becb. All fixtures use synthetic routes.

A2 consent check: no tool or test flips a draft state to a published state. The approval record of spec D21 is the consent gate, and it holds Daniel's word. Page B shows model routes and aggregate rates. It names no person or school, so no named-subject consent gap exists.

A6 registry check: measure/tracks.md:40 lists model_guide as pending and claims no resolved security state. Plan task 1.15 marks work complete with exit-code evidence only, and my reruns match it: preview-gate 76 passed, input-check 15 passed, real-work 19 passed, leak-guard 2 passed, each alone with --maxWorkers=1.

Shell safety: bash -n preview.sh exits 0. set -euo pipefail sits at preview.sh:24. Every expansion is quoted. The Python heredoc marker is quoted. The only rm -rf is the trap on the mktemp folder. No eval or temp-file path from user input exists. real-work.ts holds one write at lines 382-383, after every refusal, and it never copies the input file. JSON.parse at real-work.ts:178 is unwrapped, but a throw there exits before the single write and creates no file, so it is not a finding.

Scope: the round-3 range also holds daily_model_schedule files and harness/schedule-tests files. They belong to another track and are outside this audit. The six model_guide files match the planned 1.14 and 1.15 task lists.
Route parity: Red 1.14 ran on GLM, Green 1.15 on Kimi, and this review runs on volcengine ark-code. The review family differs from both implementation families.
